items.exampleEn: Fresh crab is a delicacy in this fishing town.
items.exampleZh: 新鮮的螃蟹是這個漁港小鎮的佳餚。

items.exampleEn: The machine broke because it was used improperly.
items.exampleZh: 那台機器因為使用不當而壞掉了。

items.exampleEn: He was wrongly accused of taking the money.
The movie has a creepy song that I can't forget.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影有一首讓人毛骨悚然的歌，我一直忘不了。
items.glossZh: 令人毛骨悚然的；詭異的

items.exampleEn: The price of the tickets was kept artificially low.
Their wedding photos were taken in a picturesque garden.
items.exampleZh: 他們的婚紗照是在一座風景如畫的花園拍的。

items.exampleEn: The bustling city never seems to sleep.
items.exampleZh: 這座熙熙攘攘的城市似乎從不休息。

items.exampleEn: The meeting felt pointless because nothing was decided.
items.exampleZh: 那場會議什麼都沒決定，感覺毫無意義。

items.sentenceEn: It's pointless to wait any longer; the bus isn't coming.
items.sentenceZh: 再等下去也沒用，公車不會來了。

items.audioEn: The story my uncle told was a little creepy, so my little sister held my hand all the way home.
items.audioZh: 叔叔講的故事有點嚇人，所以妹妹一路牽著我的手回家。
items.questionZh: 妹妹為什麼一路牽著我的手？
options: She was cold and very tired
The story scared her a bit

items.sentenceEn: This pond was made artificially, but it looks completely natural.
items.sentenceZh: 這個池塘是人工造的，但看起來完全像天然的。

items.sentenceEn: The station was bustling with travelers before the holiday.
items.sentenceZh: 假期前，車站擠滿了熙來攘往的旅客。

items.stemEn: The package was ____ delivered to the house next door.
items.stemZh: 那個包裹被錯送到隔壁那戶人家。

items.stemEn: The village is so ____ that artists come every summer to paint it.
items.stemZh: 那個村子風景如畫，每年夏天都有畫家來作畫。

items.passageEn: On my first night in Tainan, a friend took me to a bustling night market. We tried many local delicacies, such as fried chicken and red bean soup. At one stall, the candy was artificially colored bright blue and green, and the children around us loved it. Later, we saw that someone had parked a scooter improperly, blocking the narrow path, so everyone had to squeeze past it. Even so, it was a wonderful night, and I can't wait to go back.
items.passageZh: 我在台南的第一個晚上，朋友帶我去一個熱鬧的夜市。我們吃了很多當地美食，像是炸雞和紅豆湯。有一攤的糖果被染成鮮豔的藍色和綠色，周圍的小孩都好喜歡。後來，我們看到有人把機車亂停，擋住狹窄的走道，大家只好從旁邊擠過去。即使如此，那還是個美好的夜晚，我等不及想再去。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼大家要從旁邊擠過去？

items.promptZh: 那間沒人用的工廠晚上看起來很陰森。
referenceEn: The empty factory looks creepy at night.
That empty factory looks really creepy at night.
rubricZh: 要用 creepy（例如 looks creepy）
「看起來」可寫，例如 looks、seems 等
「沒人用的」可寫，例如 empty、unused 等

items.instructionZh: 用 pointless 造一個句子，說說一件你覺得沒有意義的事。
referenceEn: I think it is pointless to buy clothes I never wear.
Arguing about small things with my brother is pointless.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 pointless（例如 it is pointless to…、is pointless）
說明是什麼事（例如 buying clothes、arguing about small things 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似：sweet bean soup／「甜豆湯」不是台灣夜市的道地說法（應為紅豆湯、綠豆湯等）；建議改 red bean soup／紅豆湯。
